testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel closing a modified unsaved part: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-saving-source/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:91:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel closing a modified unsaved part ✔ Given the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user creates and finishes an empty sketch on the XY datum plane ✔ And the unsaved part containing that sketch is active ✔ And save-change prompts are configured to always show ✔ When the user closes the document tab ✔ Then a save-changes prompt offers Yes, No and Cancel ✔ When the user chooses Cancel ✔ Then the part remains active ✔ And its sketch remains in the model browser
